info.name: Cardly API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Cardly — digital business card platform.

## Authentication
All protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` header.

## Base URL
Default: `http://localhost:5050/api`

request.description: Login with email and password. Returns JWT token.
Reset password using the token from email.
Request an OTP for email verification.
Check if current user is authenticated.
Check if the user account is active (not blocked).
